root_cause.text: NFS LOCALIO page cache allocations used GFP_KERNEL (including __GFP_FS), allowing direct reclaim to recursively invoke nfs_writepages and cause a deadlock.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `nfs_local_mapping_set_gfp_nofs_context()` which clears `__GFP_FS` from the mapping’s GFP mask, and calls it in `nfs_local_iocb_alloc()` and `nfs_local_run_commit()`. The commit message explicitly states the fix prevents direct reclaim recursion into NFS via `nfs_writepages` by ensuring GFP_NOFS context for all page cache allocations.

intent_record.intent_summary: Set address_space GFP mask to NOFS to prevent direct reclaim recursion back into NFS via nfs_writepages.
intent_record.what: Added a new static function nfs_local_mapping_set_gfp_nofs_context that clears the __GFP_FS flag from the GFP mask of a given address_space.
intent_record.how: This ensures page cache allocations use GFP_NOFS, preventing direct reclaim from triggering NFS writeback (nfs_writepages) and avoiding potential recursion or deadlocks.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add call to set GFP_NOFS context on file mapping to prevent memory reclaim recursion during NFS local I/O.
intent_record.what: Added a call to nfs_local_mapping_set_gfp_nofs_context(file->f_mapping) before init_sync_kiocb in nfs_local_iocb_alloc.
intent_record.how: This call modifies the GFP flags of the file's address_space mapping to include __GFP_NOFS, preventing memory allocation during I/O from recursively entering the filesystem and causing deadlocks.

intent_record.what: Added a call to nfs_local_mapping_set_gfp_nofs_context(filp->f_mapping) before the dprintk and vfs_fsync_range in nfs_local_run_commit.
intent_record.how: The call sets the address space mapping's GFP flags to NOFS context, preventing potential filesystem reclaim recursion or deadlocks when performing the subsequent vfs_fsync_range operation.

candidates.rationale: This call to vfs_fsync_range can trigger NFS page writeback (nfs_writepages) which allocates page cache pages with the default GFP_KERNEL mask. Without a prior mapping_set_gfp_mask to GFP_NOFS, a memory reclaim recursion deadlock occurs when direct reclaim re-enters NFS through nfs_writepages.

bic_trace_step.code_snippet:
commit 70ba381e1a431245c137ed597ec6a05991c79bd9
Author: Weston Andros Adamson <dros@primarydata.com>
Date:   Thu Sep 5 15:09:53 2024 -0400

    nfs: add LOCALIO support
    
    Add client support for bypassing NFS for localhost reads, writes, and
    commits. This is only useful when the client and the server are
    running on the same host.
    
    nfs_local_probe() is stubbed out, later commits will enable client and
    server handshake via a Linux-only LOCALIO auxiliary RPC protocol.
bic_trace_step.reason: The code in `nfs_do_local_read()` uses `GFP_KERNEL` when calling `nfs_local_iocb_alloc()` (line ~190 in diff). This includes `__GFP_FS` which allows direct reclaim to recursively invoke NFS writepages, causing deadlock. The write path correctly uses `GFP_NOIO`, but the read and commit paths (`nfs_local_commit` uses `GFP_KERNEL` for `nfs_local_fsync_ctx_alloc`) retain the unsafe flag. No fix is present.
